title:
Governance
and innovation

elements.text: A team needs to launch quickly. Security needs consistent controls. The platform team wants reuse.

elements.alt: Practitioners balance shared controls and freedom to innovate.

elements.text: APIOps Cycles helps them agree which decisions to make together and which can remain local.
For example: shared access rules, with local implementation choices.

notes: APIOps Cycles / Osaango Ltd. Method content CC-BY-SA 4.0. Original artwork retained from the supplied Pariisi-Messuvihko.pptx. Illustrative scenario. Shared and local decisions depend on organizational context.
